node.selection: Pinned after Windows/WSL and real-chain compatibility checks. Bundled SQLite 3.53.4 includes the FTS5 fix recorded as CVE-2026-11822/11824; Node exposes defensive mode, SQL authorization and resource limits. This release also fixes SQLite binding null returns under memory pressure. No unreviewed addon or production service installation.

solana.selection: Stable Agave local validator and bundled SBF builder for the solana-program 3.0.0 / SPL Token interface 2.0.0 API graph. Replaces the inherited 1.18 dependency graph with a known curve25519-dalek advisory. Local validation only; not production approval.

integrityNotes: Archive hashes pin the bytes fetched over HTTPS from official release/source endpoints. Node and Gitleaks archives were also compared with official checksum lists. These checks do not constitute an independent audit or release-signature attestation.
